connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.3: streams graph rebuilt on proven engine mechanisms — the bare-text /embed-url step is gone. Now: title page (html-attr-json) -> slug -> composed episode URL /anime/{titleID}-{slug}/{episodeID} -> embed_url attribute -> vixcloud embed page -> direct MP4 with the SUB_ITA/ITA marker gating on qualityLabel. Four-step cap respected (3 steps). Gating semantics unchanged.
